svg.text: Define how the compiler is to treat warnings inside this project.
These settings can be overriden with Class/Module/procedure attributes:

g.text: Use of legacy DefType statements is strongly discouraged
This variable has been auto-declared by the compiler due to Option Explicit being OFF
Datatype has not been explicitly declared so will default to Variant
[Exit Sub/Function] inside a Property-Get procedure is only supported for backwards compatibility.
Record length is ignored in binary mode
Use of legacy date/time property-let assignments are strongly discouraged
Possible misuse of hexadecimal literal notation
It is strongly recommended to specify an [ InterfaceId() ] attribute for this class
The inline ByVal attribute is ignored on User Defined Types
Use of legacy DLL {LEGACY.DLL} has been redirected to {MODERN.DLL}
